name: domstamp-gym
description: Framework-neutral, lossless browser-state snapshots for automation and AI agents.

scripts.docs:check: cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check --root site --tsconfig tsconfig.json
scripts.publint: publint run packages/domstamp --strict --pack=false && publint run packages/tq1 --strict --pack=false && publint run packages/playwright --strict --pack=false && publint run packages/puppeteer --strict --pack=false
scripts.attw: attw --pack packages/domstamp --profile esm-only && attw --pack packages/tq1 --profile esm-only && attw --pack packages/playwright --profile esm-only && attw --pack packages/puppeteer --profile esm-only
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run docs:check && npm run docs:build && npm run publint && npm run attw
